name: HIST 3502W
title: Colonial America: Native Americans, Slaves, and Settlers, 1492-1760
description: (Also offered as AMST 3502W.) The legacy of Columbus, creative survival of native Americans in the face of disease and warfare, religious utopianism and the profit motive in colonization. The growth of a distinctive Anglo-American political culture, gender and family relations, and the entrenchment of a racial caste system.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to juniors or higher.
